channel.title: BotsDoThat Weekly
channel.description: A few practical jobs you can hand to AI each week, with copy-paste prompts.

item.title: Let AI shop, plan and sort for you (it asks first)
item.description: This week's picks are about AI that does things, not just answers: buying, booking, sorting and nudging. Each prompt below tells the AI to stop and ask you before any money moves or anything gets shared or deleted. Copy one, fill in the brackets, and try it. In this issue: Let your AI find and buy things for you with Shop Pay; Add an AI to your friends' group chat to make plans happen; Organize your photos by just asking; Get a text from your bot before something needs doing.

item.title: 4 jobs you can hand to an AI this week
item.description: Welcome to the first BotsDoThat Weekly. Each week we pick a few real, practical jobs people are handing to AI, tell you what you end up with, and give you a prompt you can copy. No hype, no made-up numbers. In this issue: Have an agent research a used car from its listing link; Have an agent line up contractor quotes for a home project; Send a long video or thread to your bot with one reply; Set spend limits and usage alerts on your AI accounts.
